table.text: In this randomized, double-blind, controlled intervention study (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT06073652), infants were recruited from 3 medical centers in the metropolitan Manila (Philippines) area between August 2023 and February 2024.

Infants aged ≥14 to ≤35 days were enrolled if they met the following inclusion criteria: healthy term infant (≥37 weeks of gestation); birth weight ≥2500g and ≤4500g; and at the time of enrollment, infants were exclusively consuming and tolerating a cow's milk infant formula and their parents have independently elected not to breastfeed before enrollment.

The infants who met the eligibility criteria were randomized to receive the synbiotic formula (SynF) or the control formula (CtrlF) in a 1:1 allocation ratio using the Medidata Randomization Trial Supply Management (New York, United States) with the dynamic allocation algorithm.
Written informed consent was provided by the parent(s)/legally authorized representative(s) (LAR) prior to study enrollment.
Parent(s)/legally authorized representative(s) provided written informed consent prior to study enrollment.

power.title: Power Analysis Check

table.text: The sample size for this trial was determined using the primary endpoint of weight gain in g/day to 4 months of age and the key secondary endpoint of sIgA concentration per dry fecal weight at 4 months. To show a non-inferiority boundary of -3g/day with a power of 80%, 88 infants per arm would be required for the primary endpoint. Based on the differences in sIgA concentrations observed across groups in a previous study and an α-level of 5%, it was estimated that 108 infants per arm would be needed to demonstrate superiority of sIgA. With the assumption of a 10% attrition rate, each group would need 120 infants (240 in total). No pre-specified interim efficacy analyses were performed.

live_data_statements: A total of 243 infants in Manila, the Philippines were screened and 240 were randomized into the CtrlF (n=122) and SynF (n=118) groups forming the Intention-To-Treat (ITT) dataset (Fig. 1a).

In this randomized, double-blind, controlled intervention study (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT06073652), infants were recruited from 3 medical centers in the metropolitan Manila (Philippines) area between August 2023 and February 2024.

Infants aged ≥14 to ≤35 days were enrolled if they met the following inclusion criteria: healthy term infant (≥37 weeks of gestation); birth weight ≥2500g and ≤4500g; and at the time of enrollment, infants were exclusively consuming and tolerating a cow's milk infant formula and their parents have independently elected not to breastfeed before enrollment.

The infants who met the eligibility criteria were randomized to receive the synbiotic formula (SynF) or the control formula (CtrlF) in a 1:1 allocation ratio using the Medidata Randomization Trial Supply Management (New York, United States) with the dynamic allocation algorithm.
Written informed consent was provided by the parent(s)/legally authorized representative(s) (LAR) prior to study enrollment.
